suggested_requirements.text: The system shall provide one-point access to data from research sites in standardized formats.
The system shall translate data from location-specific formats into the standardized STEWARDS formats.
The system shall allow users to access, search, analyze, visualize, download, and report integrated watershed data.
The system shall provide graphical and tabular interface tools for viewing and downloading data.
The system shall provide a metadata search tool to query dataset parameters.
The system shall provide web-based geographic information tools to allow site-specific data to be viewed within their spatial context.
The system shall provide tools for database contributors to create and upload metadata compatible with the STEWARDS metadata database.
The system shall support multiple levels of data aggregation of time-series data (daily, monthly, or yearly).
The system shall provide a non-graphical interface option.
The system shall provide a warning message when a low transmission speed is detected.
The system shall use user/password authentication to enable user settings management and access to protected data.
The system shall use single-sign-on systems like Microsoft Active Directory for authentication.
The system shall be available 24 hours per day, 7 days a week with 99% availability.
The system shall show no visible deterioration in response time as the number of users increases.
The system shall provide metadata query response times of a few seconds or less.
The system shall operate with Microsoft Internet Explorer 5.0/6.0, Netscape Communicator 4.7, Netscape 6/7, and FireFox.
The system shall provide an online hierarchical and cross-linked help system in HTML.
The system shall provide a user's guide containing instructions for accessing and using the data system.
The system shall use the Microsoft SQL Server database engine.
The system shall be in compliance with all Accessibility, Web Design, and Security policies applicable.
The system shall back up all user and application data as well as software installation and configuration files week-nightly.
The system shall provide secure, off-site storage on a weekly basis with 24-hour retrieval times.
The system shall use load balancing at the application level for application and database servers.
The system shall use a back-end private network environment to isolate end-user operations from large back-end data transfers.
